metadata.description: Plugins that help an agent work on your local network, for Canopy users. Pinned to reviewed commits.

plugins.name: network-playbook
plugins.description: Document a home network so it can be rebuilt after a move: scan and probe it, then keep a printable PDF playbook and an agent-readable JSON definition.

plugins.name: network-forensics
plugins.description: Network forensics for home and small networks: trace a device's egress at the firewall, document it, lock it down, verify.

plugins.name: opnsense-mgmt
plugins.description: Manage an OPNsense router/firewall via SSH and the OPNsense API — guided first-run onboarding, firewall rule inspection, network debugging, and host/log diagnostics. Per-host config is stored outside the plugin so the same install works across multiple environments.

plugins.name: linux-bt
plugins.description: Bluetooth on Linux from the command line, because the desktop pairing dialogs are unreliable. Diagnose the adapter, scan, pair + trust + connect in one non-interactive bluetoothctl session, manage known devices (connect, disconnect, forget, battery) and reset the stack. BlueZ 5.x; works the same under KDE, GNOME or no desktop.

plugins.name: cloudflare
plugins.description: Build, test, and deploy applications on Cloudflare with platform guidance Skills and the Cloudflare MCP server.

plugins.name: tailscale
plugins.description: Manage Tailscale tailnet resources via curl+jq scripts with operationId-based invocation, dry-run previews, and explicit write confirmation.

plugins.name: docker-manager
plugins.description: Slash commands and subagents for managing Docker containers, Compose stacks, volumes, networks, and multi-environment deployments.

plugins.name: ubuntu-admin
plugins.description: Agent skills for administering Ubuntu machines, desktop or server, locally or over SSH: health and diagnosis, apt/snap/flatpak packages and updates, systemd services and logs, Docker, storage and backups, networking (netplan/NetworkManager), hardware, desktop odds and ends, and shell config. Consolidates linux-desktop-mgmt, linux-server-mgmt and sysadmin-homelab.

plugins.name: ubuntu-security
plugins.description: Agent skills for host security on Ubuntu desktops and servers: ufw firewall setup, status, scoped allows, rule removal and block diagnosis; ClamAV / rkhunter / chkrootkit / Lynis / AIDE install, definition updates, scans and scheduling; read-only security audits, security-update and spyware/telemetry checks; SSH keys, SSH server config and fail2ban; YubiKey/FIDO2 and fingerprint authentication; TLS certificate checks.

plugins.name: proxmox-mgmt
plugins.description: Manage a Proxmox VE host via SSH and the Proxmox API — guided first-run onboarding, VM/CT lifecycle, storage and ZFS inspection, log review, and update workflows. Per-host config is stored outside the plugin so the same install works across multiple Proxmox environments.

plugins.name: synology-mgmt
plugins.description: Manage a Synology NAS via SSH — guided first-run onboarding, share/volume inspection, storage health, and file operations. Per-host config is stored outside the plugin so the same install works across multiple NAS environments.

plugins.name: home-assistant-skills
plugins.description: Agent skills for Home Assistant: best practices for automations, helpers, templates, scenes, blueprints, device control, dashboards, AppDaemon, and backups.

plugins.name: homeassistant-config
plugins.description: Write, check and modernise Home Assistant YAML (automations, scripts, templates, blueprints, dashboards) with the syntax of Home Assistant 2026

plugins.name: home-assistant-mgmt
plugins.description: Manage a Home Assistant instance via SSH and the HA REST API — guided first-run onboarding, automation/entity authoring, service calls, TTS testing, and log review. Per-host config is stored outside the plugin so the same install works across multiple Home Assistant environments.

plugins.name: mqtt-observability
plugins.description: Observe and interact with an MQTT broker — monitor all payloads, watch a specific topic, and publish messages. Stores broker credentials once and reuses them.

plugins.name: zigbee-home-maintenance
plugins.description: Maintain a home Zigbee network — onboard MQTT broker, coordinator (SMLight / Sonoff / ConBee / etc.), and Home Assistant; manage credentials, network exports, and routine maintenance.
